title: Bihar BPSC Stenographer Final Answer Key 2026 – Out
vacancyDetails: 15 Stenographer posts; final answer key after provisional key and objections
qualification: As per BPSC Stenographer Advt 01/2026 (Intermediate + stenography skill)
ageLimit: As per BPSC rules for the advertisement
selectionProcess: Written Exam → Skill Test → Document Verification
documentsRequired: Admit card, registration credentials for login, photo ID for record
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bpsc.bihar.gov.in
2. Open Notices / Final Answer Key for Advt 01/2026 Stenographer
3. Download Final Answer Key PDF (set-wise / subject-wise)
4. Match booklet series with your question paper
5. Await result based on final key
shortDescription: BPSC Stenographer Final Answer Key 2026 out on 22 July for exam held on 11 June 2026 (15 posts, Advt 01/2026).
content:
Bihar Public Service Commission has released the Final Answer Key for Stenographer recruitment (Advt. No. 01/2026) on 22 July 2026.

Written exam: 11 June 2026. Provisional key was out on 8 July 2026. Vacancies: 15.

Download final PDF from bpsc.bihar.gov.in. Result will be prepared on the basis of the final answer key.
